caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a stylized animal head, resembling a dragon or wolf, constructed as a mask or puppet. The head has a long, angular snout that is colored primarily in dark tones, including blacks and deep greens, with patches of yellow, blue, and brown. The inside of the open mouth shows pinkish-red triangular teeth on both the upper and lower jaws, and the tongue is colored orange. The eye is green with a dark pupil and yellow markings above, and the head features two pointed, black ears or horns on top. The lower part of the head extends downward into a dark, textured fabric or material, mostly black and blue, suggesting it is worn over the head. The background is a plain, beige color, and there is a signature at the bottom right that reads "Charles E. Makins."
title: Hand Puppet - Snapdragon
